basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast and lifelong learner, residing in Austin, Texas. With a background in electrical engineering and a penchant for home automation projects, I spend my days working as a systems analyst for a tech firm. Evenings are usually dedicated to exploring new scientific theories and indulging in my passion for science fiction, particularly the 'Three Body Problem' series. I'm in a long-term relationship and enjoy spending weekends hiking with my partner. My active Reddit hours are typically late evenings, post 9 PM CST, when I unwind and engage in community discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in electrical engineering from a reputed university, my expertise in technology is complemented by self-taught skills in programming and automation. My job as a systems analyst keeps me updated with the latest tech trends and innovations. I also regularly engage with academic papers and online courses to expand my understanding of complex scientific concepts.
